name: Ondes
author: krimple
summary: Ondes Martenot-style instrument for MPC OS 3.x: eight combinable timbres, an intensity key (pedal, aftertouch or velocity), ribbon mode with hold for the touch strip, hand vibrato, transposition buttons, Legato/Mono/Poly voices and presets in the PRESET field. Tested on an MPC Key 61 (MPC OS 3.10.1).
